_about: LED profile layouts to compare, all straight runs parallel to the walls. kind 'corner' layouts sit in the room's corners so walls and ceiling stay free for acoustic panels; kind 'free' layouts place profiles anywhere. A corner run follows one of the twelve edges of the room's box: 'ceiling <wall>' and 'floor <wall>' where that wall meets the ceiling or floor, 'corner <end>-<side>' for the four vertical corners. from and to are metres along the edge (default: its whole length): along the long walls from the back wall, along the end walls from the window wall, up the corners from the floor. Every profile is a 45 degree corner profile aimed diagonally into the room. defaults apply to every run unless it says otherwise. A free run gives start and end points [x, y, z] in scene metres (room centre, floor at 0), aim (the direction its diffuser faces, across the run) and a label for the figures.

variants.name: Ceiling ring
variants.note: All four wall–ceiling edges: one continuous rectangle of light.

variants.name: Long coves
variants.note: The two long wall–ceiling edges: two parallel lines, open at the ends.

variants.name: Lit end walls
variants.note: Both vertical corners and the ceiling edge at each end wall: a glowing upside-down U on the back wall and on the street wall.

variants.name: Floating room
variants.note: Both long walls at the ceiling edge and at the floor edge: four parallel lines, so the room seems to hover.

variants.name: Around the desk
variants.note: An L around the mix corner: the ceiling edges over the mural wall and the back wall, and the corner where they meet. The window wall and street end stay dark.

variants.name: Skirting glow
variants.note: All four floor edges, washing light up the walls.

variants.name: Opposite corners
variants.note: The ceiling edge over the window wall and the floor edge along the mural wall: two lines in diagonally opposite corners.

variants.name: Work end, lounge end
variants.note: Ceiling edges around the mix end, floor edges around the street end: bright above where you work, low where you relax.

variants.name: Every edge
variants.note: All twelve edges of the room: the room drawn as a lit wireframe, the brightest option to compare against.

variants.name: Inset ceiling lines
variants.note: Two lines on the ceiling, lengthwise, 60 cm in from each long wall, shining down.

runs.label: ceiling line by the window wall
ceiling line by the mural wall

variants.name: Pendant over the desk
variants.note: A suspended profile 1 m above the desk, running across it, and two ceiling lines down the middle of the room.

variants.name: Wall grazers
variants.note: A line along each long wall shining up the wall and onto the ceiling: at 2.4 m on the mural wall, and at 2.95 m above the window heads on the window wall.

variants.name: Cross rhythm
variants.note: Five short lines across the ceiling, each in line with a long-wall window, leaving the gaps between for panels.

variants.name: Centre spine
variants.note: One line down the middle of the ceiling, and a line behind the desk at shelf height washing the back wall.
